scope: Closed ideal four-gas column at fixed common temperature with composition and pressure redistribution in prescribed rigid pores. Stationary-solid-frame flux; all partial concentrations are evolved. No chemistry, heat equation or material qualification.
entropy_definition: Relative ideal-gas entropy -R*sum(n_i*ln(c_i/c_ref)); c_ref=P_ref/(R*T). Terms linear in conserved species amounts are omitted. This includes concentration/pressure redistribution, not only composition mixing. Not full absolute thermochemistry or a heat equation.
physical_input_classification: Source-qualified approximate free-gas binary D and Wilke viscosity, porous DGM local laws. Explicit straight-capillary-bundle geometry with permeability porosity*radius^2/8; not a measured brick pore network. Initial partial-pressure profiles are declared numerical qualification inputs.
